description: This file defines a Java interface named CustomerAccountXRefRepository which extends JpaRepository to manage CustomerAccountXRef entities. It provides methods to find account mappings by customer ID and account ID, acting as a data access layer for customer-account cross-reference data in a bank application.

classes.name: CustomerAccountXRefRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing CustomerAccountXRef entities, providing custom finder methods.

methods.name: findByCustomer_Id
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAccountXRef entities associated with a specific customer ID.

methods.name: findByAccount_Id
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAccountXRef entities associated with a specific account ID.
